must: Use existing Ryvo pink, violet, gold, surface, radius, and motion tokens
Show only native storefront localized real-money prices
Keep gift artwork catalogue-driven and replaceable without business-logic changes
avoid: TikTok branding or copied gift artwork
Continuous animation on historical gift messages
Decorative complexity that slows chat scrolling

decisions.decision: Use compact three-column gift tiles, an existing BottomSheet hierarchy, a gold balance surface, and separate branded gift cards instead of ordinary text bubbles.
decisions.reason: Matches Ryvo's established mobile density and tokens while keeping selection, balance, and send actions legible in one-handed chat use.

decisions.decision: Adapt the 21st Messaging Conversation structure into Ryvo's full-screen ChatScreen using grouped content-width bubbles, mobile ActionSheets, embedded reply previews, and the same read-only bubble renderer for the official Ryvo thread.
decisions.reason: Keeps the selected 21st conversation rhythm while preserving Ryvo tokens, realtime/media/gift behavior, one-handed actions, and Android scrolling performance without retaining demo primitives or a second color system.
